slides.lead: Your inbox is part of the product. Treat it like one.
Same address in the app, the App Store page and your bio.
"Got it, looking into it" beats a perfect answer three days later.
Login help, account deletion, bug reports. Write them once.
The repeats tell you what to fix next.
The person who reported a bug is your best early user. Treat them like it.

slides.h2: Support isn't a distraction. It's free user research.
slides.lead: Every message is someone telling you exactly what's broken.
